annotations.title: Latest stored DNS reading of one name

description: The latest stored DNS reading of one name, with its parking venue. Use it when someone asks whether a name points anywhere or is parked, and with which parking service. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: read, ns, a, aaaa, cname, mx, hasWebsite, parking.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

name: ud_get_name_dns

next.description: The next page on the API, when there is one.
